title: Mohd Suhel Live
description: Get ready for an evening of unapologetic laughs with Mohd. Suhel Live — a stand-up comedy show where Suhel dives into brutally honest takes on his life, his parents, his brother, and everything that makes family gatherings weirdly funny. From Mumbai versus Delhi banter to dark, deadpan humor and a few jokes that almost got him into trouble, Suhel brings it all with a straight face and razor-sharp timing. It’s a mix of relatable, risky, and ridiculously funny stories that make you laugh, flinch, and nod all at once. If you love sharp observational comedy, a bit of edge, and a comic who says the things everyone’s thinking but no one says out loud — this one’s for you. Book your tickets now for Mohd. title: Are You Marriage Material? (Compatibility Show)
description: Are You Marriage Material? A Comedy Panel Show About Love, Laughs, and Life Together Think you’re ready for “forever”? Or just want to watch others hilariously find out? Are You Marriage Material? is a laugh-out-loud live panel show where comedians put singles and couples through outrageous, revealing, and downright ridiculous challenges to see if they’ve got what it takes to be “marriage material.” From navigating a fake in-law encounter to budgeting for love and arguing over wedding plans, no test is too absurd—and no verdict too savage. With a rotating panel of witty comedians judging your every move, this show blends stand-up, improv, and interactive games for a night of big laughs and surprising truths. description: From balance sheets to punchlines — Banker OP in The House is Piyush Sharma’s hilarious take on life as a banker-turned-comedian. title: Bali Ka Basra by Tushar Basra - A Stand Up Solo
description: After resonating with audiences online through his takes on middle-class madness, Delhi households, and the quiet horror of growing up “just fine,” Tushar Basra is now hitting the road with his stand-up comedy solo — Bali Ka Basra. This hour-long show blends crisp storytelling, sharp punchlines, and hilarious truths about engineering college dreams, awkward first jobs, and everything in between. If you’ve ever lived in a shared flat, stood in a queue unnecessarily, or been stuck in a meeting wondering what your job really is—this show will feel oddly personal. Tushar Basra is touring with this show across India, so grab your tickets, bring your friends and family, and come be part of an evening where laughter is the only thing that’s guaranteed and affordable.
